verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability documents natural-language interaction with telemetry and an AI SRE agent, so an MCP-client capability is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions connecting or plugging in external MCP servers or using their tools. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
